missing_information_behavior: If any required safety or context information is missing, do not add positive recommendation score; request clarification or escalate.
safety_exclusions: Do not treat culinary turmeric as equivalent to concentrated supplements; do not recommend high-bioavailability formulations without safety assessment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Jaundice, dark urine, pruritus, abdominal pain, known liver disease or hepatotoxic medicines require clinician review.
population_and_context: Users with liver disease, symptoms or exposure to concentrated turmeric/curcumin products.
dose_constraints: No dose; avoid recommending concentrated curcumin until liver safety and product formulation are assessed.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH turmeric information; reports of liver injury are rare but clinically important; formulation and bioavailability matter. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
